evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: we talk a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns either they're worried that the movers won't show up on time or that their items will be damaged. Now. Would either of those concern you or do you have any other specific concerns?

top_strength: Amy delivered a comprehensive inventory deep-dive, capturing all special items and logistics in detail, which ensures the estimate will be accurate and the crew is well-prepared.
coaching_note: Step 2 needs a real second layer: when Natalie raised the concern about movers not showing up, Amy jumped to a solution instead of asking 'Tell me more about that' or 'What happened?' — layer deeper before pivoting to your answer, and also reflect concerns back as a summary (Step 2, Active Listening) before moving forward.
